We've guided hundreds through admissions. Now we're bringing that experience, alongside a big team with wealth of expertise in top-tier admissions, directly to students who deserve better than guesswork.

reviews.name: Rasulbek Artikboyev
reviews.feedback: When I came to IVYBEK in my gap year, I was not sure. I hestiated because I didn't know if my investment would pay off. But I'd noticed: my peers who’d got in had studied in an admissions program. So I joined IVYBEK Academy. Using the outreach strategies from the lessons, I landed internships at CERR—Uzbekistan's leading think tank—and YESU. Then I learned how to cold-email profs. So I began doing research with a PhD from Georgetown. Now I've achieved my dream: full-ride from Georgetown Q and BYU–Idaho in the United States of America.

reviews.name: Baxtiyor Babadjanov
reviews.feedback: I got into UToronto, #1 uni in Canada. What I liked most about the IVYBEK Admissions Program was the push. Individual consultations were literal reality checks. Mentor’s harsh yet honest feedback, mixed with fines imposed by Levsha (levsha) for missed tasks, made it work harder week by week. But rather soon enough, I was spending mornings at the archive as an assistant to Johns Hopkins Uni Prof, afternoons at my internship, and evenings writing my research paper - a schedule I wouldn’t have believed was mine just a few months earlier.

reviews.name: Akmaljon Kholmirzayev
reviews.feedback: On day one, Asadbek (Levsha) assigned 3 500+ word reflections: impossible-seeming for an ALWIUT who'd only written IELTS essays. I finished at 1am, and the next assignment was already waiting. Since then, IVYBEK team never stopped pushing us. These results came through sleepless nights and long hours of prep. IVYBEK's writing techniques, in-depth explanations, and extracurricular guidance built my app from scratch. With them, I wrote my first research paper, joined a startup, raised investment, and scaled my projects across regions.

reviews.name: Botirjon Kholmatov
reviews.feedback: My name is Botirjon Xolmatov, and I was admitted to University College London, the 8th-ranked university in the world. Last year, questions like ‘What even is a portfolio? How do I do research? Which universities should I even apply to?’ used to bother me. After joining Ivybek Academy, I landed an internship, started doing research with leading professors in Uzbekistan, and started writing my essays. Our 6 months of hard work bore fruit. I won a 100% grant to my dream university, UCL. Ivybek’s team played a huge role in achieving this success. I recommend Ivybek Academy to you all too.
